status_vocabulary.PASS: accepted with revision, commands/exits, input hashes and independent check attached
status_vocabulary.FAIL: a required property does not hold; keep the counterexample
status_vocabulary.NOT_MEASURED: the population/denominator is empty or the measurement was not performed
status_vocabulary.OWNER_PENDING: a real open owner checkpoint blocks the dependent work
status_vocabulary.DESCRIPTIVE_INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT: n below the support floor; the slice stays visible, no headline
status_vocabulary.RED_CONFIRMED: a capability gap reproduced on a pinned unchanged build (not a regression, not a suite PASS)
status_vocabulary.REVISE: protocol/interpretation not acceptable as input until the named corrections are applied
status_vocabulary.DEFERRED_BY_OWNER: explicitly moved out of this sprint by an owner decision
